answer.thought: The haze thickens as the afternoon deepens, a brown blanket that muffles the noise of the market. I have had enough food; the chole bhature sat heavy, a reminder that even the Germanic spirit must submit to the physical needs of the system. I will sit a while longer, watching the few shoppers drift by, before the heat forces me back to the bungalow.
